title: GeoMoneyStream
tagline: Real-time income/revenue based on mobility geolocation information
description: In this project, Superfluid was used to implement a prototype of mobility that realizes real-time income and outcome based on geolocation information. This is expected to be used as an incentive for specific movements in self-driving cars and community car-sharing, as well as for location-based entertainment.
how_its_made: The front end was built using Deno and Fresh and deployed to Deno Deploy. This allowed us to continue a fast development experience with no build steps. Twind was used for styling. For the map component, a key part of the UI, we used leaflet.js for interactivity. Money streaming is implemented using Superfluid.
